headline: RBI rate hike expectations divide impact between banks and NBFCs
hook: Margin pressure meets asset repricing advantages
summary: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates for the first time in three years, impacting financial institutions differently. Higher funding costs are likely to squeeze profit margins for non-banking financial companies. Meanwhile, lenders with floating-rate assets and strong liquidity positions stand to benefit from the shifting rate cycle. Brokerages have highlighted selective institutional favorites including HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Bajaj Finance, and Tata Capital.

why_it_matters: Select lenders gain while NBFC margins face pressure.
